description: This file is the entry point for a React application. It imports React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component, then renders the App inside an element with ID 'root' using React's createRoot API.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React component tree into a DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the DOM at the root created by ReactDOM.createRoot.
